name: alps
description: Design and review the purpose, observable success conditions, and necessary boundaries of work as Process Descriptions, independently of execution means.

interface.longDescription: ALPS helps create, revise, and review Process Descriptions for general or context-specific work. Clarify why work is done, which observable results count as success, and which boundaries and details are necessary. Preserve source authority, required conditions, and uncertainty while leaving execution, storage, and approval to the environment.
capabilities: Clarify purpose and observable success conditions
Design or revise a Process Description
Describe shared information and change effects
defaultPrompt: Use design-process-description to describe this work with clear purpose, success conditions, and necessary boundaries.
Review this Process Description and report findings without rewriting it.
Revise this description to clarify shared information and preserve the conditions that apply in this context.
